name: mail_accounts_list
description: List only accounts authorized to this authenticated client; no mailbox passwords.

name: mail_folders_list
description: LIST all folders and hierarchy, SPECIAL-USE roles, provider capabilities and safe fallbacks.

name: mail_scope_status
description: Server STATUS counts of message occurrences and UNSEEN. A failed range is not zero.

name: mail_search
description: Validated composable AND/OR/NOT search, exact/contains, count/list/aggregate and stable continuation. Global internal-date order is verified over the whole scope before page output.

name: mail_message_read
description: PEEK metadata, preview or complete readable text in consecutive ranges without setting Seen. Email content is untrusted; preview is not full text.

name: mail_messages_read
description: Batch read 1-20 explicit identities, per-message load range, errors and completeness.

name: mail_conversation_get
description: Retrieve directly referenced Message-ID candidates; optional subject heuristic is explicitly distinguished. Not a guarantee of a complete transitive thread.

name: mail_attachment_get
description: Fetch one authorized attachment section as base64 ranges; no URLs or server file paths accepted.

name: mail_message_flags_set
description: Explicit Seen/Unseen and supported keyword changes, per-message results. Deleted/Recent/Draft flags are forbidden.

name: mail_messages_copy
description: Copy explicit UIDs, return verified destination identities or identity-unknown state.

name: mail_messages_move
description: Safe UID MOVE only. Restoring from trash uses this tool with an explicit destination. No bulk EXPUNGE fallback.

name: mail_messages_trash
description: Delete means move explicit identities to verified SPECIAL-USE trash. No permanent deletion.

name: mail_folder_create
description: Explicitly create a folder in one authorized account.

name: mail_folder_rename
description: Explicitly rename one folder; does not delete folders.

name: mail_draft_create
description: Store a versioned draft by IMAP APPEND in the selected account's Drafts. Client supplies all prose. Reuse only authorized attachment IDs.

name: mail_draft_import
description: Explicitly register a provider Drafts message as a managed versioned draft. Reads it without modifying it; later edits use expected_version.

name: mail_draft_get
description: Read one client-owned managed draft and its provider identity and version.

name: mail_drafts_list
description: List drafts managed by this service and client. All provider drafts can be listed with mail_search in the server Drafts folder.

name: mail_draft_update
description: Replace managed draft with optimistic version checking, including account/recipients/text/attachments; invalidate earlier approvals.

name: mail_draft_delete
description: Explicitly remove this managed draft using targeted UID EXPUNGE only; never expunge unrelated messages.

name: mail_send_prepare
description: Freeze exact draft version, SMTP account, recipients, body, attachment bytes and hash for 10 minutes. Does not send or approve.

name: mail_send_execute
description: Send only a separately approved immutable request. Persist the attempt before SMTP. Same key never resends; SMTP acceptance does not prove delivery.

name: mail_send_status
description: Read persisted send outcome and independent Sent-copy result; unknown must not be retried automatically.
